subject.title: Reconnect supervisor hangs on zombie WSS — no event/log emitted, requires manual restart

question: Should OpenClaw recover a stale Slack Socket Mode transport through the linked bounded-waiter approach, and what recovery threshold is acceptable for quiet but healthy workspaces?
rationale: The reported failure is source-backed and user-impacting, but selecting the authoritative transport signals and reconnect threshold affects channel stability and requires live Slack behavior judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the linked repair
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/112816 with live Slack evidence that healthy quiet connections do not reconnect spuriously.

options.title: Request a narrower recovery design
options.body: Keep the issue open while defining a smaller transport-liveness contract before accepting a bounded reconnect waiter.
